body: The kit is sealed and pushed behind a rat-chewed board. One bandage has been set on top, dry and neatly folded as if someone expected to return for it.
title: The first-aid kit under the kitchen shelf

body: The empty sprayer is tacky around its trigger. A notebook page has dried against its side; the page shows a rat-chewed root beside three crop rows.
title: The spray bottle with a page stuck to it
